steps: Found right door mirror for Akera

lines.reason_short: Right heated blind-spot mirror is the Akera fit.
lines.reason_long: Mirror knocked off means a full right mirror assembly is needed. This Akera has the heated blind-spot version, which is not returnable.

lines.reason_short: Blind-spot sensor needs calibrating after mirror replacement.
lines.reason_long: The new mirror carries the blind-spot sensor on this Akera. Calibration is needed to make sure it reads correctly.

lines.reason_short: Check the door skin and wiring plug.
lines.reason_long: A knocked-off mirror can damage the door moulding area and the mirror wiring connector. Check both before fitting the new mirror.

result.reply: I suggested the right heated blind-spot mirror and its sensor calibration for this CX-5.
